ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISPICKVAL(StageName, "Take the Keys"), OR( ISBLANK(AF_InvoiceSummary__c), AF_InvoiceBalance__c <> 0 ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Take the Keys requires a settled Invoice Summary: either no invoice has been created for this deal yet (a reservation must be made first), or the invoice balance is not yet zero.
